summary: Bush-backed east kerb on a quiet street, homes 22-25 m across the road.
reasons: Quiet residential street, cars park opposite

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the van's side; nearest dwellings 22-24 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Public sealed street; east edge is bush with a narrow verge, room to stop looks tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the west side only; nothing on the bush side to show a convention.

flags: Steep: about 5-9% grade along the stretch
Homes within about 25 m across the road
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy from the east; shaded most of the day, some afternoon sun through the road gap.

best_section.where: Ironside Street east kerb, beside the bush opposite the middle houses
